name: SetReplace
html: Engine for set and hypergraph substitution systems: WolframModel, causal and token–event graphs, multiway and local multiway evolution, hypergraph plots.

name: HypergraphRewritingEngine
html: Parallel and GPU multiway hypergraph rewriting with exact canonicalization, deterministic results and an interactive visualiser.

name: Hypergraph
html: Hypergraphs, hypergraph rewriting and hypermatrix algebra, including the hypergraph insertion bracket.

name: Multicomputation
html: Multiway systems and the Multi container for multicomputational models.

name: QuantumFramework
html: Quantum states, operators, circuits and measurements; Nik wrote its early code base, with the Wolfram quantum computation team.

name: DiagrammaticComputation · Lambda
html: Compositional string-diagram calculus (with Ian Ford) and lambda-calculus diagrams and trees.

name: Infrageometry
html: Experimental code for geometry emerging from large graphs at large observer scales, with companion repositories for causality, analysis and gauge theory.

name: Hyperiad
html: A browser notebook for hypergraph rewriting and higher-arity mathematics, from the Arity Science programme.

name: PostTagSystem · CombinatorEvolve
html: Fast evolvers for Post tag systems and combinators, used in the corresponding studies of computational irreducibility.
